name: Easy Login for ScalaHosting SPanel
author: WP Fix It - WordPress Experts

sections.description:
ScalaHosting EASY Login – SPanel Only lets you embed a secure single-sign-on button into any post, page or widget area, giving administrators one-click access to your ScalaHosting SPanel or HostPanel.

This plugin provides WordPress administrators with an easy way to integrate a secure single sign-on (SSO) experience into their ScalaHosting SPanel. Once configured, the [scalahosting] shortcode can be added anywhere in your content, displaying a customizable login button.

Features:

  • Adds ‘[scalahosting]’ shortcode for login button

  • Administrator-only access: non-admins see nothing

  • Live button preview and styling options in the Tools ScalaHosting settings page

  • Supports both ‘/spanel’ and ‘/hostpanel’ login paths

  • Button color, hover color, text color & size configurable

  • Secure SSO via ScalaHosting API with nonce protection
